verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's only AI evidence is "AI-powered creation of meeting minutes," which is AI generation of a document rather than insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The personalized license/permit summary and compliance-status notifications are tailored to the user's business, but nothing says they are AI-generated. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or recommendations from user data, an in-product AI assistant or suggestion surface, detailed documentation of how AI features work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
